knowledge_graph.title: North Augusta High School
knowledge_graph.type: High school in North Augusta, South Carolina
knowledge_graph.description: North Augusta High School is a four-year public high school located in North Augusta, South Carolina. It is a part of the Aiken County Public School District. Approximately 1,500 students attend the school. The school offers over thirty student organizations.
